books.name: Genesis
books.kjvTitle: The First Book of Moses, called Genesis

books.name: Exodus
books.kjvTitle: The Second Book of Moses, called Exodus

text.quote: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

books.name: Leviticus
books.kjvTitle: The Third Book of Moses, called Leviticus

books.name: Numbers
books.kjvTitle: The Fourth Book of Moses, called Numbers

text.quote: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

books.name: Deuteronomy
books.kjvTitle: The Fifth Book of Moses, called Deuteronomy

text.quote: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.

books.note: Deuteronomy 34 reports Moses' death and burial.

books.name: Joshua
books.kjvTitle: The Book of Joshua

text.quote: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

books.kjvTitle: The Book of Judges

books.kjvTitle: The Book of Ruth

books.note: GotQuestions lists Ezra for Nehemiah; the book opens "The words of Nehemiah".

books.name: Esther
books.kjvTitle: The Book of Esther

books.name: Job
books.kjvTitle: The Book of Job

text.who: David and 6 others in the psalm titles

books.name: Proverbs
books.kjvTitle: The Proverbs

text.quote: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

books.note: Proverbs 30:1 opens the words of Agur and 31:1 the words of king Lemuel.

books.name: Ecclesiastes
books.kjvTitle: Ecclesiastes or, the Preacher

text.who: the Preacher, the son of David
text.quote: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

books.name: Song of Solomon
books.kjvTitle: The Song of Solomon

text.quote: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

books.name: Isaiah
books.kjvTitle: The Book of the Prophet Isaiah

text.quote: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

books.name: Jeremiah
books.kjvTitle: The Book of the Prophet Jeremiah

text.quote: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

books.note: Jeremiah 36:4 says Baruch wrote Jeremiah's words from his mouth.

books.name: Lamentations
books.kjvTitle: The Lamentations of Jeremiah

books.name: Ezekiel
books.kjvTitle: The Book of the Prophet Ezekiel

text.quote: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.

books.name: Daniel
books.kjvTitle: The Book of Daniel

text.quote: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.

books.name: Hosea
books.kjvTitle: Hosea

text.quote: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

books.name: Joel
books.kjvTitle: Joel

text.quote: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

books.name: Amos
books.kjvTitle: Amos

text.quote: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

books.name: Obadiah
books.kjvTitle: Obadiah

text.quote: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

books.name: Jonah
books.kjvTitle: Jonah
books.note: The book tells Jonah's story in the third person.

books.name: Micah
books.kjvTitle: Micah

text.quote: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

books.name: Nahum
books.kjvTitle: Nahum

text.quote: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

books.name: Habakkuk
books.kjvTitle: Habakkuk

text.quote: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

books.name: Zephaniah
books.kjvTitle: Zephaniah

text.quote: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

books.name: Haggai
books.kjvTitle: Haggai

text.quote: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,

books.name: Zechariah
books.kjvTitle: Zechariah

text.quote: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

books.name: Malachi
books.kjvTitle: Malachi

text.quote: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.

books.name: Matthew
books.kjvTitle: The Gospel According to St. Matthew

books.name: Mark
books.kjvTitle: The Gospel According to St. Mark

books.name: Luke
books.kjvTitle: The Gospel According to St. Luke

text.who: a writer who says "it seemed good to me also"
text.quote: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

books.name: John
books.kjvTitle: The Gospel According to St. John

text.who: "the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things"
text.quote: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

books.name: Acts
books.kjvTitle: The Acts of the Apostles

text.quote: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

books.name: Romans
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Romans

text.quote: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

books.name: 1 Corinthians
books.kjvTitle: The First Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Corinthians

text.quote: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

books.name: 2 Corinthians
books.kjvTitle: The Second Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Corinthians

text.quote: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

books.name: Galatians
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Galatians

text.quote: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

books.name: Ephesians
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Ephesians

text.quote: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

books.name: Philippians
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Philippians

text.quote: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

books.name: Colossians
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Colossians

text.quote: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

books.name: 1 Thessalonians
books.kjvTitle: The First Epistle of Paul to the Thessalonians

text.quote: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

books.name: 2 Thessalonians
books.kjvTitle: The Second Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Thessalonians

text.quote: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

books.name: 1 Timothy
books.kjvTitle: The First Epistle of Paul the Apostle to Timothy

text.quote: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

books.name: 2 Timothy
books.kjvTitle: The Second Epistle of Paul the Apostle to Timothy

text.quote: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

books.name: Titus
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle of Paul to Titus

text.quote: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

books.name: Philemon
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle of Paul to Philemon

text.quote: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

books.name: Hebrews
books.kjvTitle: The Epistle to the Hebrews
books.note: GotQuestions lists the writer as unknown, with Paul, Luke, Barnabas or Apollos named as the likeliest.

books.name: James
books.kjvTitle: The General Epistle of James

text.quote: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

books.name: 1 Peter
books.kjvTitle: The First Epistle General of Peter

text.quote: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

books.name: 2 Peter
books.kjvTitle: The Second Epistle General of Peter

text.quote: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

books.name: 1 John
books.kjvTitle: The First Epistle General of John

books.name: 2 John
books.kjvTitle: The Second Epistle of John

text.quote: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

books.name: 3 John
books.kjvTitle: The Third Epistle of John

text.quote: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

books.name: Jude
books.kjvTitle: The General Epistle of Jude

text.quote: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

books.name: Revelation
books.kjvTitle: The Revelation of St. John the Divine

text.quote: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

books.note: Revelation 1:4 and 1:9 name John again ("I John").
